name: LiveKit Agents
summary: LiveKit Agents is an open-source framework for building voice, video and text agents that join LiveKit WebRTC rooms as realtime participants. It handles turn detection, interruptions, STT/LLM/TTS plugins, SIP telephony and multi-agent handoffs. Agents can be self-hosted or deployed on LiveKit Cloud.
goodFor: Production voice agents over WebRTC and phone
watchOut: You run a LiveKit server or pay for LiveKit Cloud
Fast release cadence means frequent upgrades
